scoring_justification: T1 recompute is infeasible because absolute DFT energies strongly depend on pseudopotential choice, k‑point sampling, and convergence thresholds, which are not fully prescribed and would be code‑dependent. The paper’s core claims are structural: a global minimum at ~4.5 wt% Mg in absorption energy and barrier ratios ≥1.5×. These can be verified directly from the agent’s computed data points without requiring a hidden gold value.

mg_wt_percent.description: Mg doping content in weight percent

outputs.description: Li absorption energies on pure Li and Li-Mg surfaces across a range of Mg doping levels. The checker will verify that a clear global minimum exists consistent with the expected doping.

pure_Li_barrier_eV.description: Li migration barrier on pure Li(100) surface, in eV

Li_Mg_toward_barrier_eV.description: Li migration barrier on Li-Mg surface toward the Mg atom, in eV

Li_Mg_away_barrier_eV.description: Li migration barrier on Li-Mg surface away from the Mg atom, in eV

outputs.description: Li migration energy barriers on pure Li and Li-Mg surfaces. The checker will verify that the Li-Mg barriers are significantly larger than the pure Li barrier.

output_contract.notes: Only the single-Mg absorption energy trend and the three migration barriers are scored; the two-Mg absorption energy illustration and all experimental battery results are excluded.
